title: Episode 295: CityStrides vs Graph Algorithms vs GPT 5.6 Sol

sentences.en: If the listener is wondering, hmm, I wonder if his wife is going to let him do this when they have a two-week-year-old that is crying a lot, the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 如果听众在想，嗯，不知道他妻子在他有个两周大、哭闹不停的孩子时，还会不会让他这么做，答案是不会。

sentences.en: My hobby is going to be, I would say very sadly, but not sadly, because we're starting a family and that, to be honest, is much more exciting.
sentences.zh: 我的爱好将会，我得说非常遗憾，但也不算遗憾，因为我们要组建家庭了，老实说，这要令人兴奋得多。

sentences.en: Like, odds are I would never have this hobby if I didn't make it to the age of 35 with no children, no dependents, and no serious responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果我不是到了35岁还没孩子、没家属、没重大责任，我可能永远也不会有这个爱好。

sentences.en: There was an Instagram reel one time that I saw, like, a few years ago that said, if you're born in 1990, you're doing one of the following three things.
sentences.zh: 几年前我曾在Instagram上看到一个短视频，上面说，如果你是1990年出生的，你现在肯定在做以下三件事之一。

sentences.en: One, getting married, two, starting a family, or three, running a marathon.
sentences.zh: 第一，结婚；第二，组建家庭；或者第三，跑马拉松。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 295, recorded on July 13th, 2026.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听ADSP播客，第295期，录制于2026年7月13日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we chat about city strides, graph algorithms, GPT 5.6, Seoul, and more.
sentences.zh: 我是Connor，今天我和我的联合主持人Bryce一起，聊聊City Strides、图算法、GPT 5.6、首尔等等话题。

sentences.en: It's exciting times.
sentences.zh: 现在是个激动人心的时代。

sentences.en: Okay, okay, all right.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So first thing, so listen, I, despite me being very AI forward, I'm still like an old man.
sentences.zh: 首先，听着，尽管我非常推崇人工智能，但我骨子里还是个老派的人。

sentences.en: And by that, I mean, like, there's some places where I'm using AI everywhere,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些地方我确实到处都在用AI，

sentences.en: but there's a lot of other places where I feel like I see other people on the internet using AI to solve parts of their life in ways that I just,
sentences.zh: 但在很多其他方面，我看到网上其他人用AI解决生活中的问题，而我却，

sentences.en: I've just been too stubborn or haven't been able to get the momentum to, like, adopt.
sentences.zh: 我一直太固执，或者说一直没能下定决心去采用这些方法。

sentences.en: Like, I haven't been using, like, an AI personal assistant for anything.
sentences.zh: 比如，我从来没用过AI个人助理来处理任何事情。

sentences.en: Like, I don't have it, like, reading my emails or writing my emails.
sentences.zh: 我没让它帮我读邮件或写邮件。

sentences.en: I don't have it, like, managing my to-do list, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 也没让它帮我管理待办事项等等。

sentences.en: And I mostly have just been using it for coding.
sentences.zh: 我大部分时间只是把它用在编程上。

sentences.en: And in kind of, like, a dumb way.
sentences.zh: 而且是以一种比较笨拙的方式。

sentences.en: Like, I don't have, I use all these, like, persistent, I use all these ephemeral agents that, like, run in VMs.
sentences.zh: 我用的都是那些运行在虚拟机里的临时代理，而不是持久化的。

sentences.en: I don't, like, build up, like, a deep skill library.
sentences.zh: 我没有建立深度的技能库。

sentences.en: I don't build up a deep memory library.
sentences.zh: 也没有建立深度的记忆库。

sentences.en: Like, I feel like I'm using it in a very different way than other people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我使用它的方式和别人很不一样。

sentences.en: But I kind of, I've kind of, like, recognized, I've started to recognize that more and more of my time is being, or AI has accelerated so much of parts of my, you know, work.
sentences.zh: 但我已经开始意识到，我的时间越来越多地被AI加速了，或者说AI加速了我工作中的很多部分。

sentences.en: You know, like, accelerated my output in so many places that the places where I used to not think about wasting time, I'm now, like, crap.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它在很多地方加速了我的产出，以至于以前我从不觉得是在浪费时间的地方，现在我会想，糟了。

sentences.en: Like, I just spent three hours, like, going through my email inbox and think about all the stuff I could have done in that time.
sentences.zh: 比如，我刚才花了三个小时处理收件箱，想想这段时间我本可以做多少事。

sentences.en: And the thing that I started using last week was computer use and, like, browser use.
sentences.zh: 我上周开始使用的一项功能是计算机操作和浏览器操作。

sentences.en: And the reason I started using it is kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 我开始使用它的原因挺有意思的。

sentences.en: So, if you go to ChatGPT or ClaudeCode or Codex, like, the CLI, or you just go to ChatGPT and you tell it, like, hey, go get me prices for this specific flight.
sentences.zh: 如果你去用ChatGPT、ClaudeCode或Codex之类的命令行工具，或者直接在ChatGPT里告诉它，嘿，帮我查一下这趟特定航班的价格。

sentences.en: Like, I want to fly from New York to Toronto on this date.
sentences.zh: 比如，我想在某天从纽约飞往多伦多。

sentences.en: Go get me prices for it.
sentences.zh: 帮我查查价格。

sentences.en: What I want it to do is I want it to, like, go to Google Flights or Expedia or any of the tools that, like, I use to go and price out flights.
sentences.zh: 我希望它能去Google Flights、Expedia或者任何我平时用来查票价的工具上操作。

sentences.en: Or, like, maybe I'll ask it for hotels.
sentences.zh: 或者，也许我会让它帮我查酒店。

sentences.en: And, again, I have, like, you know, some set of tools I want it to go and use.
sentences.zh: 同样，我有一套我希望它去使用的工具。

sentences.en: And what I've found is it just doesn't have access to a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 但我发现它根本无法访问很多东西。

sentences.en: And I think what happens is if you ask it to go to, like, flights.google.com or, like, on some sites, some sites either need to log in to get useful information.
sentences.zh: 我觉得问题在于，如果你让它去flights.google.com或者某些网站，有些网站要么需要登录才能获取有用信息。

sentences.en: Another good example of this is if you ask it to look up a tweet.
sentences.zh: 另一个很好的例子是，如果你让它查找一条推文。

sentences.en: Sometimes if somebody vague posts something, instead of me trying to figure out what they're, like, alluding to in their post, I'll just, like, send a link of it to ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: 有时候如果有人发了条含糊不清的推文，我不想去猜他们到底在暗示什么，我就会把链接发给ChatGPT。

sentences.en: But I don't actually send a link anymore because if I give it a link to Twitter, it can't actually see the tweet in a lot of cases.
sentences.zh: 但我现在其实不发链接了，因为如果我给它Twitter链接，很多情况下它根本看不到那条推文。

sentences.en: I'll send it a screenshot instead.
sentences.zh: 我改发截图了。

sentences.en: But with the flights thing, if it goes to flights.google.com, it can't actually pull up data there.
sentences.zh: 但对于航班查询，如果它去flights.google.com，它实际上无法提取数据。

sentences.en: And I don't know if it's because it needs a login or if it's that when it goes to that site,
sentences.zh: 我不知道是因为需要登录，还是因为当它访问那个网站时，

sentences.en: that's, like, when an agent or any sort of automated system goes to a website,
sentences.zh: 当代理或任何自动化系统访问网站时，

sentences.en: there's some protocol where it asks the website, like, hey, you know, I'm a robot.
sentences.zh: 有一种协议会询问网站，嘿，你知道，我是个机器人。

sentences.en: Can I come look at your site?
sentences.zh: 我能看看你的网站吗？

sentences.en: This, like, robots.txt thing.
sentences.zh: 就是这个robots.txt之类的东西。

sentences.en: And there's a bunch of sites that are, like, no, go away.
sentences.zh: 有很多网站会说，不，走开。

sentences.en: So it's either that or it's the login thing.
sentences.zh: 所以要么是这个原因，要么是登录问题。

sentences.en: And so there's this set of tasks that I want it to be able to do that it just can't do because it doesn't have the access that it needs.
sentences.zh: 所以有一系列我希望它能完成的任务，它却因为没有所需的访问权限而无法完成。

sentences.en: And then sometimes there's, like, a website I want it to use where, like, it doesn't have an API.
sentences.zh: 还有时候，我想让它使用的网站没有API。

sentences.en: You know, like, it's something where it's not easy to interact with.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是那种交互起来很不方便的网站。

sentences.en: And that's specifically why I want the agent to deal with it because, like, it would require a million clicks on this annoying website for me to go and do something.
sentences.zh: 这正是我希望代理来处理的原因，因为如果让我自己去操作，那个烦人的网站需要点上几百万次鼠标。

sentences.en: Like, oh, I want to go apply for some visa for some country or something where, you know, websites for visas are notoriously, like, awful to interact with.
sentences.zh: 比如，哦，我想去申请某个国家的签证，你知道，签证网站的操作体验通常是出了名的糟糕。

sentences.en: And so there's this thing called, like, computer use where basically instead of, like, going through an API or even just, like, looking at the HTML of the website,
sentences.zh: 所以就有了所谓的“计算机操作”，基本上它不是通过API，甚至不是通过查看网站的HTML代码，

sentences.en: it interacts with your browser or some app on your computer just, like, the same way you would with, like, point and click.
sentences.zh: 而是像你一样，通过点击鼠标来与你的浏览器或电脑上的某个应用进行交互。

sentences.en: You know, like it controls the mouse.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像它在控制鼠标一样。

sentences.en: And it really saddens me that this is, like, this has to be one of the most inefficient ways for an AI to interact with something.
sentences.zh: 让我感到难过的是，这竟然成了AI与事物交互最没效率的方式之一。

sentences.en: Like, it goes to the website and I literally watch it going through and, like, entering stuff into form fields and, like, clicking buttons and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 它访问网站，我亲眼看着它一步步操作，在表单里输入内容，点击按钮之类的。

sentences.en: And it's just got to be so, like, wildly inefficient.
sentences.zh: 这肯定是非常、非常低效的。

sentences.en: But it does kind of get the job done.
sentences.zh: 但它确实能把事情办成。

sentences.en: Like, I had it automate a lot of the, like, flight tracking and, like, flight search and award, like, redemption tracking stuff that I do.
sentences.zh: 比如，我让它自动化处理了很多航班追踪、航班搜索以及我做的奖励兑换追踪工作。

sentences.en: And I was, like, pretty happy with it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到相当满意。

sentences.en: It was funny, though, to see, like, the AI complaining about how slow the website was, like, sort of validated for me, like, it took it, like, five hours to create, like,
sentences.zh: 不过挺好笑的是，看到AI抱怨网站有多慢，反而验证了我的想法，它花了五个小时才创建了，

sentences.en: 20 flights worth of tracking on this one website.
sentences.zh: 在这个网站上追踪了20个航班。

sentences.en: And I'm, like, crap, did I used to spend five hours doing this myself?
sentences.zh: 我心想，糟了，我以前是不是也花了五个小时自己做这些事？

sentences.en: Anyways, I don't know if you started using any of this, but for me, at least, it's been very powerful.
sentences.zh: 总之，不知道你有没有开始用这些功能，但对我来说，它非常强大。

sentences.en: I haven't done any computer use stuff, but.
sentences.zh: 我还没做过任何计算机操作相关的事情，不过。

sentences.en: Like, I'll give you an example.
sentences.zh: 我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: I bet you that there is something related to running that you do that involves using some website that has a not great UI that doesn't have, like,
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌，你跑步时肯定涉及使用某个界面不太好、没有简单API访问权限的网站，

sentences.en: an easy API to access that you probably interact with semi-regularly that you could probably automate with computer use.
sentences.zh: 你可能经常要和它打交道，而你完全可以用计算机操作来自动化它。

sentences.en: Well, it's funny that you guessed that, because I was trying to figure out how to articulate what I've been doing with my running.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你猜对了真有意思，因为我一直在想怎么表达我跑步时在做的事情。

sentences.en: But the problem is, is that, like, I have this, like, multi-headed hydra of different stuff that, I mean, we've talked about this, actually.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，我有一个多头九头蛇般的各种琐事，其实我们聊过这个。

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure we have, let me check on the website, ADSP, an episode that had the word, did it have City, yeah, it had episode 149, 2023, September 29th, citystrides.com,
sentences.zh: 我确定我们聊过，让我查查网站，ADSP，有一期节目提到了City，对，第149期，2023年9月29日，citystrides.com，

sentences.en: graph algorithms and more.
sentences.zh: 图算法等等。

sentences.en: And we never actually talked about, in depth, how to solve it.
sentences.zh: 我们当时从来没有深入讨论过怎么解决它。

sentences.en: I just, like, threw the problem out there.
sentences.zh: 我只是把问题抛了出来。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you go to the GitHub discussion.
sentences.zh: 不知道你有没有去GitHub讨论区看看。

sentences.en: I know that we got a couple comments.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们收到了一些评论。

sentences.en: And remind me, at the end of this 30-minute discussion, to talk about GitHub discussion things again.
sentences.zh: 提醒我，在这30分钟讨论结束时，再聊聊GitHub讨论区的事情。

sentences.en: Anyway, so we, I have mentioned that this very tricky problem that I tried to solve at one point.
sentences.zh: 总之，我提到过这个我曾经试图解决的非常棘手的问题。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I can explain it a bit again.
sentences.zh: 所以，我可以再解释一下。

sentences.en: But let's take a step back.
sentences.zh: 但让我们退一步看。

sentences.en: For those of you that recall, one of my biggest things that I spend time on is a website called citystrides.com.
sentences.zh: 对于记得的人来说，我花时间最多的事情之一是一个叫citystrides.com的网站。

sentences.en: It ranks, or it tracks, you upload your Strava, or you connect your Garmin or Strava.
sentences.zh: 它会对你上传的Strava数据进行排名或追踪，或者你连接Garmin或Strava。

sentences.en: And it tracks all the routes, the GPX files that you run.
sentences.zh: 它会追踪你跑步的所有路线和GPX文件。

sentences.en: And then it figures out how many streets that you've completed.
sentences.zh: 然后计算出你完成了多少条街道。

sentences.en: And the tricky thing about this is you don't actually need to run the full length of the street.
sentences.zh: 这里棘手的地方在于，你其实不需要跑完街道的全长。

sentences.en: You just need to run over the nodes that define the street.
sentences.zh: 你只需要跑过定义这条街道的节点即可。

sentences.en: So, some streets only have two nodes, a start and an end, because they're very short and they're straight.
sentences.zh: 所以，有些街道只有两个节点，起点和终点，因为它们很短且笔直。

sentences.en: Other streets are very, very long and they're windy.
sentences.zh: 其他街道则非常非常长，而且弯弯曲曲。

sentences.en: So, you need a bunch more nodes.
sentences.zh: 所以，你需要更多的节点。

sentences.en: And so, my hobby is going and doing this.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的爱好就是去干这个。

sentences.en: In 2023, I don't know, you'd have to go back and listen to that episode.
sentences.zh: 2023年的时候，我不知道，你得回去听听那一期节目。

sentences.en: I was probably in the top 100, top, you know, couple hundred.
sentences.zh: 我当时可能排在前100名，前几百名吧。

sentences.en: You do know this because you actually referred to it when we were walking in Venice and I was collecting the nodes.
sentences.zh: 你肯定知道，因为我们在威尼斯散步时你还提到过，当时我正在收集节点。

sentences.en: But I have become, like, obsessed.
sentences.zh: 但我已经变得，怎么说呢，痴迷了。

sentences.en: Like, to say, I can't remember who said it once, that I don't have passions, I have obsessions.
sentences.zh: 就像，我不记得是谁说过，我没有爱好，我有的是痴迷。

sentences.en: But, like, if I was, you know, focused on city strides and collecting nodes back in June, I am now, like, a full-blown, like, addict.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果说六月份我还在专注于City Strides和收集节点，我现在已经是一个彻头彻尾的“瘾君子”了。

sentences.en: I have gone and written two – well, technically, I wrote one Python graph algorithm to generate, like, optimal roots.
sentences.zh: 我已经写了两个——好吧，严格来说，我写了一个Python图算法来生成最优路线。

sentences.en: And I've become, like, an open street map.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经成为了一个OpenStreetMap，

sentences.en: I wouldn't say expert, but there's, like, an equivalent, an open source equivalent of –
sentences.zh: 我不敢说是专家，但有一个开源的等价物——

sentences.en: We're going to talk about that Python script in a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿再聊那个Python脚本。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I wrote it initially in Python, and then I was like, this is too slow, I need to speed it up.
sentences.zh: 是的，我最初是用Python写的，后来觉得太慢了，需要加速。

sentences.en: Let's convert it to, you know, Rust, why not?
sentences.zh: 干脆把它转换成Rust吧，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: And then I just got ChatGPT to do it, and it worked amazingly, Matt.
sentences.zh: 然后我就让ChatGPT帮我做了，效果好得惊人，Matt。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: And, anyways, my point is, I've become very much obsessed, and I'm going to be – I said this on my other podcast as well, that I'm currently ranked, you know,
sentences.zh: 总之，我的意思是，我已经变得非常痴迷，而且我将要——我在另一个播客上也说过，我目前的排名，你知道，

sentences.en: I think at the time on my other podcast, I was ranked 116th.
sentences.zh: 我想在另一个播客录制时，我排在第116位。

sentences.en: I'm now ranked 114th.
sentences.zh: 我现在排在第114位。

sentences.en: I will be ranked number one in my lifetime, probably within the next few years.
sentences.zh: 我有生之年一定会排到第一名，可能就在未来几年内。

sentences.en: I'm now ranked 13th in the world, soon to be number one in, like, a decade.
sentences.zh: 我现在世界排名第13位，十年内很快就会成为第一。

sentences.en: And I spend, like, especially right now, because it's two months before Shima's due date, I'm trying to complete the entirety of Toronto before she gives birth.
sentences.zh: 我花了很多时间，尤其是现在，因为离Shima的预产期还有两个月，我正试图在她生孩子之前跑完多伦多的所有街道。

sentences.en: Because once my son is here, right now the hobby consists of me – it used to be just going for a run, you know, running some weird route, and then getting some streets.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦我儿子出生，现在的爱好就包括我——以前只是去跑步，你知道，跑一些奇怪的路线，然后完成一些街道。

sentences.en: But I have completed every single street within, like, a seven-kilometer radius of where I live.
sentences.zh: 但我已经跑完了我家方圆七公里内的每一条街道。

sentences.en: And so, now what I have to do is hop in the car, you know, drive anywhere from 15 to 20 minutes, sometimes more if it's traffic's bad on, like, a weekend.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我必须跳上车，开车15到20分钟，周末交通堵塞的话有时更久。

sentences.en: And then I go park the car in some parking lot of a grocery store.
sentences.zh: 然后把车停在某个杂货店的停车场。

sentences.en: I start my run from there and my run and then drive back home.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始跑步，跑完后再开车回家。

sentences.en: And if the listener is wondering, hmm, I wonder if his wife is going to let him do this when they have a two-week-year-old that is crying a lot.
sentences.zh: 如果听众在想，嗯，不知道他妻子在他有个两周大、哭闹不停的孩子时，还会不会让他这么做。

sentences.en: But the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 答案是不会。

sentences.en: My hobby is going to be – I would say very sadly, but not sadly, because we're starting a family and that, to be honest, is much more exciting.
sentences.zh: 我的爱好将会——我得说非常遗憾，但也不算遗憾，因为我们要组建家庭了，老实说，这要令人兴奋得多。

sentences.en: Like, odds are I would never have this hobby if I didn't make it to the age of 35 with no children, no dependents, and no serious responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果我不是到了35岁还没孩子、没家属、没重大责任，我可能永远也不会有这个爱好。

sentences.en: There was an Instagram reel one time that I saw, like, a few years ago that said,
sentences.zh: 几年前我曾在Instagram上看到一个短视频，上面说，

sentences.en: If you're born in 1990, you're doing one of the following three things, one, getting married, two, starting a family, or three, running a marathon.
sentences.zh: 如果你是1990年出生的，你现在肯定在做以下三件事之一：第一，结婚；第二，组建家庭；或者第三，跑马拉松。

sentences.en: And the exact hobby that takes a lot of time, you know, it doesn't actually need to be a marathon, but I thought it, like,
sentences.zh: 而那个非常耗时的爱好，你知道，其实不一定非得是马拉松，但我当时觉得，

sentences.en: it nailed me so hard because at the time I wasn't getting married or having kids.
sentences.zh: 它简直说中了我，因为当时我既没结婚也没孩子。

sentences.en: I was spending a lot of time running, though.
sentences.zh: 但我确实花了很多时间跑步。

sentences.en: So, and – anyways, the point being is that I'm trying to finish Toronto, which has, like, 10,318 streets, I think, and I'm at about 8,500.
sentences.zh: 所以，总之，重点是我正试图跑完多伦多，我想那里有10318条街道，而我已经完成了大约8500条。

sentences.en: And one of the websites I actually have, it tracks the top 50 people and, like –
sentences.zh: 我关注的一个网站会追踪前50名的人，而且——

sentences.en: Has anybody else completed Toronto?
sentences.zh: 还有其他人跑完多伦多了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, three other people.
sentences.zh: 是的，还有三个人。

sentences.en: In fact, very tragically, there was a man that was raising money for, I believe, a music foundation.
sentences.zh: 事实上，非常令人悲伤的是，有位男士一直在为我记得的一个音乐基金会筹款。

sentences.en: And he was – I'm not sure if he was in his 70s or 80s, but he had cancer and he was doing it to, like, raise awareness, which really puts, like,
sentences.zh: 他——我不确定他是70多岁还是80多岁，但他患有癌症，他做这件事是为了提高人们的意识，这真的让我，

sentences.en: me doing it to shame because I'm not trying to raise awareness for anything.
sentences.zh: 让我做这件事显得很惭愧，因为我并没有想为任何事情提高意识。

sentences.en: And he, I think, just passed away in the last month.
sentences.zh: 我想他上个月刚去世。

sentences.en: And, you know, on a happy note, he completed Toronto just, like, a month or two before he passed away.
sentences.zh: 而且，往好处想，他在去世前一两个月刚刚跑完了多伦多。

sentences.en: And, anyway, so he is one of three people.
sentences.zh: 总之，他是那三个人之一。

sentences.en: Carlo – let me actually just get his name because we should shout him out.
sentences.zh: Carlo——让我查查他的名字，因为我们应该向他致敬。

sentences.en: And I'll leave a link if you want to go and leave a donation because he had a page for it.
sentences.zh: 我会留下一个链接，如果你想去捐款的话，因为他有一个筹款页面。

sentences.en: But, you know, actually, let me share my screen because I'm probably going to – but, yeah, so this is City Strides.
sentences.zh: 不过，其实，让我共享一下屏幕，因为我可能会——但，是的，这就是City Strides。

sentences.en: And the most – the number one – or, I guess, the second person in Toronto right now because every once in a while –
sentences.zh: 目前多伦多排名第一的——或者说，我想是第二名，因为偶尔——

sentences.en: How do they define Toronto here?
sentences.zh: 他们在这里是怎么定义多伦多的？

sentences.en: I see a blue line around –
sentences.zh: 我看到周围有一条蓝线——

sentences.en: Yeah, so it is, like, it's the municipality boundary defined by, like, different, you know, latitude and longitudes or whatever that are specified, I'm sure,
sentences.zh: 是的，它就是市政边界，由不同的经纬度定义，我相信，

sentences.en: in some legal document.
sentences.zh: 在某些法律文件中都有规定。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, but actually the first City Strider – so, actually, I lied.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，但其实第一位City Strider——其实，我撒谎了。

sentences.en: Four people have finished it.
sentences.zh: 有四个人跑完了。

sentences.en: And for some reason, one of them is private.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，其中一个是私密的。

sentences.en: Carlo De Lorenzi was the individual that just passed away recently and was raising money.
sentences.zh: Carlo De Lorenzi就是那位最近刚去世且一直在筹款的人。

sentences.en: The other two are named Matthew and Richard.
sentences.zh: 另外两位叫Matthew和Richard。

sentences.en: I'm good friends with Brian, who's ranked in seventh.
sentences.zh: 我和排名第七的Brian是好朋友。

sentences.en: I just passed him.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚超过了他。

sentences.en: I'm now ranked sixth.
sentences.zh: 我现在排名第六。

sentences.en: And probably in a week or two, I'll pass Steve, who's ranked in fifth.
sentences.zh: 大概一两周内，我就能超过排在第五的史蒂夫了。

sentences.en: But you have more total streets than all of these people.
sentences.zh: 但你跑过的街道总数比这些人都要多。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, so I'm definitely, like, the number one Canadian City Strider in the world.
sentences.zh: 是啊，所以我绝对是加拿大排名第一的“城市漫步者”。

sentences.en: But that's because, like, I spend a lot of time – like, it's basically every time – if I'm not training for, like, a race, and even if I am training for a race, like,
sentences.zh: 但这主要是因为我花了很多时间——基本上每次——如果我没在为比赛做训练，即使是在训练期间，比如，

sentences.en: I ran a marathon when I was in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我在爱尔兰的时候跑过一次马拉松。

sentences.en: It did not go well.
sentences.zh: 结果不太理想。

sentences.en: Arguably a part of that is that even when I'm trying to do, like, a workout, which involves, like, one kilometer repeats five times, I go in City Stride while I do that.
sentences.zh: 可以说部分原因在于，即使我在尝试做训练——比如五组一公里的间歇跑——我也会在跑步的同时开启 City Stride。

sentences.en: So, like, I'm in the middle of trying to run, like, a kilometer really fast, and I've got my phone in my hand, and I'm looking – I've got to take a left-hand turn here.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我正努力以极快的速度跑完一公里时，手里还得拿着手机，还得盯着看——我得在这里左转。

sentences.en: It's – probably I should try and do one at a time.
sentences.zh: 可能我应该一次只做一件事。

sentences.en: Either – go ahead.
sentences.zh: 要么——你先说。

sentences.en: So, I notice some streets here that look more like highways.
sentences.zh: 我注意到这里有些街道看起来更像是高速公路。

sentences.en: Is there – like, do they exclude from city streets streets that are, like, not safe for a pedestrian to go on?
sentences.zh: 有没有——比如，他们会把那些不适合行人行走的街道从城市街道中排除吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 会的。

sentences.en: I won't go into the details, but, yeah, highways and, like, high-traffic, unsafe roads are always excluded.
sentences.zh: 细节我就不展开了，但确实，高速公路和那种车流量大、不安全的道路总是会被排除在外。

sentences.en: That being said, like, when I was in –
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，当我当时在——

sentences.en: Like, I noticed this, like, Kingston Road on the far right there.
sentences.zh: 我注意到了最右边的那条金斯顿路（Kingston Road）。

sentences.en: Kingston Road is not a highway, so this is a road.
sentences.zh: 金斯顿路不是高速公路，所以它属于街道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You just haven't gotten over there.
sentences.zh: 你只是还没跑到那边去。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: That's the, like, part of Scarborough.
sentences.zh: 那是士嘉堡（Scarborough）的一部分。

sentences.en: I'm, like, 75% on Scarborough right now, which is an embedded, like, region within Toronto.
sentences.zh: 我现在完成了士嘉堡约 75% 的路段，它是一个嵌入在多伦多市内的区域。

sentences.en: So, technically, Toronto is composed of Old Toronto, which is downtown, York, East York, North York, Etobicoke, and Scarborough.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，多伦多由老多伦多（市中心）、约克、东约克、北约克、怡陶碧谷和士嘉堡组成。

sentences.en: And so, I've done everything but Etobicoke and Scarborough.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经完成了除了怡陶碧谷和士嘉堡之外的所有地方。

sentences.en: And so, if you click on Kingston Road – because you can see here that it actually says, like, there's a Kingston Road for Scarborough and there's a Kingston Road for Toronto.
sentences.zh: 如果你点击金斯顿路——因为你可以看到这里写着，士嘉堡有一条金斯顿路，多伦多也有一条金斯顿路。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the one in Toronto has more nodes because it's a superset.
sentences.zh: 多伦多的那条节点更多，因为它是一个超集。

sentences.en: And if you click on this, it'll show you, if I get rid of this, all of the dark purple ones are the nodes that I've run and the red ones aren't.
sentences.zh: 如果你点击这里，它会显示——我把这个关掉——所有深紫色的节点是我跑过的，红色的是没跑过的。

sentences.en: And it says that I'm 38.22% done this road.
sentences.zh: 上面显示这条路我已经完成了 38.22%。

sentences.en: And a very important trick that comes into the algorithm that I'll show in a little bit is that you only need to complete 90% of the nodes in order for it to be considered done.
sentences.zh: 算法中有一个非常重要的技巧，我一会儿会展示，那就是你只需要完成 90% 的节点，它就会被视为已完成。

sentences.en: And Kingston is a special road in that it's 33 kilometers long.
sentences.zh: 金斯顿路比较特殊，它有 33 公里长。

sentences.en: You're never running that all at once.
sentences.zh: 你不可能一次性跑完它。

sentences.en: And so, it just happens slowly over time.
sentences.zh: 所以它是随着时间推移慢慢完成的。

sentences.en: But most streets are anywhere from, you know, two nodes to 40 nodes.
sentences.zh: 但大多数街道的节点数在 2 到 40 个之间。

sentences.en: And so, if you have a 40-node street and one of the nodes is, like, a couple hundred meters away because it's just at the end of a long straight part of that road,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有一条 40 个节点的街道，其中一个节点在几百米外，因为它正好位于那条长直路的尽头，

sentences.en: you can actually skip that, you know, 40th node and you'll still get completion for it.
sentences.zh: 你其实可以跳过那个第 40 个节点，依然能获得完成度。

sentences.en: Hang on, hang on.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等。

sentences.en: That's cheating.
sentences.zh: 那是作弊。

sentences.en: You have to get all of the actual nodes in Toronto before the baby comes.
sentences.zh: 在宝宝出生前，你必须跑完多伦多所有的实际节点。

sentences.en: So, that is what City Stride purists say.
sentences.zh: 这就是 City Stride 纯粹主义者的说法。

sentences.en: And there's a mode called hardcore mode that you can click that requires 100%.
sentences.zh: 而且有一个叫“硬核模式”的选项，点击后要求必须达到 100%。

sentences.en: I am not hardcore.
sentences.zh: 我可不是硬核玩家。

sentences.en: I am just trying to climb this leaderboard as fast as possible, which means that I'm not trying to run the full length of these streets, which was covered in episode 149.
sentences.zh: 我只是想尽可能快地攀升排行榜，这意味着我并不打算跑完这些街道的全长，这在第 149 集里提到过。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错。

sentences.en: I'm trying to finish Toronto before the baby comes.
sentences.zh: 我正试图在宝宝出生前跑完多伦多。

sentences.en: And I did actually have, like, a route mapping if we go to – and so, actually, well, I can show you – what do I want to show you first?
sentences.zh: 我确实做过路线规划——如果我们要去——其实，我可以给你展示一下——你想先看什么？

sentences.en: This is the website that shows, like, you know, the top 50.
sentences.zh: 这个网站显示了前 50 名的排名。

sentences.en: So, there I am.
sentences.zh: 看，我在那儿。

sentences.en: And it's got a separate tab that shows, like, the completion of the sub-municipalities within Toronto and then just some other random cities that I run in often.
sentences.zh: 它还有一个单独的标签页，显示多伦多各子行政区的完成度，以及我经常跑步的其他一些随机城市。

sentences.en: Wait, you've done all – you've completed New York?
sentences.zh: 等等，你已经完成了所有——你跑完了纽约？

sentences.en: North York, not New York.
sentences.zh: 是北约克，不是纽约。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我懂了。

sentences.en: Yeah, North York.
sentences.zh: 对，北约克。

sentences.en: It's, like, the northern part of Toronto.
sentences.zh: 那是多伦多的北部地区。

sentences.en: And you can see here, like, I even have this little projection.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，我甚至还有这个小小的预测。

sentences.en: So, if I run five times a week, you know, one of the estimates say I'll finish September 3rd.
sentences.zh: 如果我每周跑五次，其中一个估算显示我会在 9 月 3 日完成。

sentences.en: The other one says October 1St.
sentences.zh: 另一个显示是 10 月 1 日。

sentences.en: And you can see that, like, in the last little bit, I've really started to go crazy.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，在最后这段时间里，我真的开始疯狂跑步了。

sentences.en: Like, when I got back from – if I zoom in a little bit here – when I got back from Ireland, basically, I've been running every single day City Striding.
sentences.zh: 比如，当我从——我放大一点——当我从爱尔兰回来后，基本上我每天都在进行 City Striding 跑步。

sentences.en: And if I kick it up to, you know, six runs a week, then it says September 3rd versus September 18th.
sentences.zh: 如果我增加到每周跑六次，那么预测就是 9 月 3 日到 9 月 18 日之间。

sentences.en: The due date is September 15th.
sentences.zh: 预产期是 9 月 15 日。

sentences.en: So, you know, it depends, though.
sentences.zh: 所以，这很难说。

sentences.en: Are we going to make it?
sentences.zh: 我们能赶上吗？

sentences.en: Maybe, maybe not.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，也许不能。

sentences.en: Stay tuned.
sentences.zh: 敬请期待。

sentences.en: And the thing that I was doing over the weekend was trying to basically create a better version of the – so,
sentences.zh: 周末我一直在做的事情是尝试创建一个更好的版本——所以，

sentences.en: if we go to City Strides – except that I don't have an old version of this because I did get rid of it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们去 City Strides——但我没有旧版本了，因为我已经把它删了。

sentences.en: Anyways, it was a very bad route planner.
sentences.zh: 总之，那是个很烂的路线规划器。

sentences.en: But it wouldn't, like, start and end at the same spot.
sentences.zh: 它不能在同一个点开始和结束。

sentences.en: And it just had a bunch of issues.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一堆问题。

sentences.en: And anyway, so I just basically, over the weekend, was talking to AI and saying, you know, these are my criteria.
sentences.zh: 总之，周末我一直在和 AI 对话，告诉它我的标准。

sentences.en: There's two different routes you want, right?
sentences.zh: 你需要两种不同的路线，对吧？

sentences.en: If you're visiting, you know, Italy, Rome, and you're only there for a couple days, you don't want to complete a whole section.
sentences.zh: 如果你去意大利罗马旅游，只待几天，你肯定不想跑完整个区域。

sentences.en: You just want the maximum number of streets possible, which means targeting the shortest streets, skipping the long streets, etc.
sentences.zh: 你只想尽可能多地覆盖街道，这意味着要针对最短的街道，跳过长街道等等。

sentences.en: But if you're trying to complete 100% of the city, you want, like, a dense, you know – and one of the biggest problems with these automatic route generations is, like,
sentences.zh: 但如果你想完成 100% 的城市覆盖，你需要那种密集的——自动路线生成最大的问题之一就是，

sentences.en: stranded streets.
sentences.zh: 孤立的街道。

sentences.en: You don't want to create a route that strands one or two streets that are going to require running an extra two or three kilometers because you left them behind.
sentences.zh: 你不想创建一条路线，导致一两条街道被孤立，最后为了跑它们还得额外多跑两三公里。

sentences.en: Anyways, I won't go into all the details because the viewer or the listener can't see this.
sentences.zh: 总之，我就不细说了，因为观众或听众看不到这些。

sentences.en: But now, like, the idea is – That stranded street thing is some sort of – there's some sort of graph property.
sentences.zh: 但现在的想法是——那个孤立街道的问题属于某种图论属性。

sentences.en: Yeah, like, and that's the thing is as I was having conversations over the weekend, like, I basically just kept on verbally explaining, like, heuristics it needed to add where,
sentences.zh: 对，这就是关键。周末我一直在交流，我基本上一直在口头解释它需要添加的启发式规则，

sentences.en: like, you know, you'll see here when I've zoomed into a road called Wonderland Drive.
sentences.zh: 比如，当你放大到一条叫 Wonderland Drive 的路时，你会看到，

sentences.en: And, like, at one point, it was generating this route that not only would run the full length of Wonderland Drive once, but it would double back.
sentences.zh: 有一次，它生成的路线不仅要跑完 Wonderland Drive 的全长，还要折返。

sentences.en: And the point being is there's no nodes in between basically, like, the start and the end of the street.
sentences.zh: 重点是，在街道的起点和终点之间基本上没有节点。

sentences.en: And so, like, not only do you not want to run it twice, you don't even want to run it once.
sentences.zh: 所以，你不仅不想跑两次，甚至连一次都不想跑。

sentences.en: You want to just get over the start and the end and, like, add that to your route.
sentences.zh: 你只想经过起点和终点，然后把那条路加入你的路线。

sentences.en: And so, I would explain this heuristic and it would be like, oh, yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以我解释了这个启发式规则，它就会说，哦，是的，有道理。

sentences.en: That makes sense.
sentences.zh: 确实有道理。

sentences.en: And then there's a bunch of other heuristics, like the, you know, minimizing the stranded streets because it completely defeats the purpose if you isolate two or three streets.
sentences.zh: 还有一堆其他的启发式规则，比如尽量减少孤立街道，因为如果你把两三条街道孤立起来，就完全违背了初衷。

sentences.en: Like, basically, like, that's a non-starter.
sentences.zh: 基本上，那是行不通的。

sentences.en: Like, it's a thing it has to get right.
sentences.zh: 这是它必须做对的事情。

sentences.en: Nodes that I have to, you know, collect so far.
sentences.zh: 我目前需要收集的节点。

sentences.en: I choose the distance.
sentences.zh: 我选择距离。

sentences.en: I go build closed loop.
sentences.zh: 我生成闭环路线。

sentences.en: And it just starts doing it.
sentences.zh: 然后它就开始运行了。

sentences.en: And that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I don't fully understand what it's doing right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在还没完全理解它在做什么。

sentences.en: And you can see whenever there's yellow nodes, those are ones that will be completed basically by hitting 90% of the nodes.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到每当有黄色节点时，那些就是通过达到 90% 节点就能完成的路段。

sentences.en: And it's not perfect yet.
sentences.zh: 它还不完美。

sentences.en: You can see here that it kind of missed this cul-de-sac.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到这里它漏掉了一个死胡同。

sentences.en: Like, if you're running by a cul-de-sac that has no other, like, that's the definition of a cul-de-sac.
sentences.zh: 如果你跑过一个死胡同，它没有其他出口——这就是死胡同的定义。

sentences.en: It just has one entrance.
sentences.zh: 它只有一个入口。

sentences.en: It should definitely get this.
sentences.zh: 它绝对应该覆盖到这里。

sentences.en: So, it's not perfect yet.
sentences.zh: 所以它还不完美。

sentences.en: But, honestly, it's pretty good.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，已经相当不错了。

sentences.en: And so, anyways, this is a long-winded response to your, like, there's probably something you spend a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 总之，这是对你关于“你肯定花了很多时间”这个问题的长篇大论的回答。

sentences.en: Every single day, basically, I go for a run.
sentences.zh: 基本上我每天都会去跑步。

sentences.en: I get back from my run.
sentences.zh: 跑完步回来。
